title: Looking back on a life crammed with famous meetings
summary: He lists notable people he met and marvels at what he fit into his years.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: So, as we begin to look at the overall picture and look back on my life, I feel like that...that I've had a very, very interesting life...I met a lot of people...cross sections. From the Vice President of the United States, Hubert Humphrey, to Jimmy Carter, to Chip Carter, to any outstanding person you name...Hazel Scott, Mrs. Roosevelt, Jackie Onassis, Bobby Kennedy...you know, any of these people that you name, I've met. You know, going from that Travis Tucker's "Let's Go" Company to many of the other things in which I participated, it takes quite a bit of doing. And I just don't see how I've been able to cram all of this into, you know, 58 years, or 71 years, total.
